\parbox{\textwidth}{\footnotesize W0: scores frozen on 31 March 2026, labels counted from April to June 2026. W1: scores frozen on 30 June 2026, labels counted from July to September 2026. In the main analysis every score is computed from the twelve months before its freeze on the graph of contracts (amounts in US dollars on five tokens, allowances counted up to the owner's balance), and the counts are taken on that graph: owner contracts with a capped allowance to the contract (in-approve degree), the summed capped value of those allowances (in-approve value), other contracts that sent it a transfer (transfer in-degree), and other contracts with an edge to it in either layer (union in-degree). 5{,}700 of the W0 spenders (72.5\%) and 5{,}759 of the W1 spenders (72.8\%) lie in the union graph; the others score zero in every row of the upper block. 1{,}725 W0 spenders gained a new approval pair and 1{,}416 a new transfer sender, and 1{,}491 and 1{,}369 W1 spenders did; in the registered analysis 3{,}403, 3{,}042, 2{,}850 and 2{,}812. In the registered analysis every score is computed in raw base units from every extracted event of every ERC-20 token since 1 October 2023, and the two counts are taken over all accounts. No value of the upper block is a registered result. The count, EndorseRank and AWP rows are reference scores that the companion study \cite{kwon2026companion} also reports. Intervals: 400 paired resamples over the contracts of the cohort, seed 42.}
